clues.title: Google car: A visible Street View car is present in most of the coverage
text: A **visible Street View car **is present in most of the coverage, being a pickup truck with the cab and bed visible. The colour of the cab and other features of it varies. In Generation 3, a **roof rack** is present. You may also find a large blur covering the entire pickup truck.

clues.title: Google car: A police car, most commonly white or black, can almost…
text: A **police car**, most commonly white or black, can almost always be seen following the Street View car. The follow cars may differ slightly from the ones shown in the image.

clues.title: Plate: Nigeria uses short licence plates that appear somewhat…
text: Nigeria uses short licence plates that appear somewhat **green** through the blur.

clues.title: Pole: Most Nigerian poles are made of concrete
text: Most Nigerian poles are made of concrete, have **indents **with a few **horizontal supports**, and are similar to the ones used in Brazil, but do not have holes through them.

clues.title: Road line: Roads are not always well-maintained in Nigeria
text: Roads are not always well-maintained in Nigeria, so roads **without roadlines **or faded roads are common. Potholes, cracked roads and unpaved roads are also relatively common.

clues.title: Architecture: Most Nigerian houses are single-storey
text: Most Nigerian houses are **single-storey**, with **steeply pitched roofs** commonly made of metal sheets. Cinder block walls surrounding the houses are also common.

clues.title: City and state names are often found on storefronts or…
text: **City and state names **are often found on storefronts or banners in Nigeria, so knowing them can be quite useful.

clues.title: Google car: Within mainland Africa, Nigeria is currently the only…
text: Within mainland Africa, Nigeria is currently the only country to have this **low-quality coverage**, known as official ari**, **or “shitcam”.

NOTE: Low quality coverage taken between 2023 and 2025 has especially [low quality](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FRmNSTEtGszBkRqEA). Often you can see huge cars through the blur, and this extremely low quality only appears elsewhere in Lebanon.

clues.title: Landscape: Nigeria is generally a fairly flat country with subtle…
text: Nigeria is generally a **fairly flat **country with subtle elevation changes throughout. The south is relatively flat apart from some noticeable hills in the southeast, in Enugu state and in the southwest, between Ife and Lokoja. In the north, more prominent hills and mountains are found from Abuja and Jimeta. The largest mountains are found in the east, making up the Mandara mountain range and the Nigeria-Cameroon border. However, due to little coverage, the mountains are rarely visible.

clues.title: Vegetation: Shown is a Köppen climate map of Nigeria
text: Shown is a **Köppen climate map** of Nigeria. The climate ranges from tropical rainforest in the [far south](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvLGJLnQZK4qnzn99), where you can find an abundance of palms with lush, green vegetation, to a more arid, [savannah landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SZQcHSZAonH1A9RD6) in the centre, with more scattered trees. In the far north, it transitions to an [arid steppe](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeiAA6fxzbj3gae47) where the vegetation becomes even more sparse.
NOTE: Due to dry/wet seasons, the coverage may look drastically greener/drier than expected for certain latitudes.

clues.title: Coverage: Nigeria is a sparsely covered country
text: Nigeria is a **sparsely covered** country, with very few roads in the northwest and east. Most of the coverage is centred around big cities and the highways that connect them.

clues.title: Nigeria is mainly Christian in the south
text: Nigeria is mainly **Christian **in the south, and **Islamic **in the north. As such, seeing women in hijabs and men in Muslim attire is more common in the north.

clues.title: These haystacks are extremely common and are almost…
text: These **haystacks** are extremely common and are almost exclusively found in Kaduna state.

clues.title: Landscape: If you find yourself in an arid
text: If you find yourself in an **arid**, but green, agricultural landscape with an abundance of **corn **around, you are likely to be in Kano state. It is only covered by shitcam, without any Generation 3 or 4.

clues.title: Landscape: Benue state can be recognized by the lush
text: Benue state can be recognized by the lush, green **grass covered ground**, with **reddish soil**. The vegetation is somewhat scattered, with the grass making way for taller trees. Shorter trees and shrubs between the grass and taller trees are somewhat uncommon. Thatched huts are also common in comparison to other southern states.
NOTE: An abundance of palms should make you lean toward the [bordering southern states](https://maps.app.goo.gl/N5KTikgLk6PNkL9X8) that can look similar.

clues.title: Vegetation: Niger state is the shitcam equivalent to Benue state
text: Niger state is the shitcam equivalent to Benue state. It is almost entirely covered by **shitcam**, and can be recognized by the scattered trees, **reddish soil**, and **dry grass**.

clues.title: Landscape: The highways that run through the northwestern states of…
text: The highways that run through the northwestern states of Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina can be recognized by an even more **open** and **arid** landscape compared to Niger state. The tree coverage becomes even more sparse, or there may [not be trees at all](https://goo.gl/maps/ProC7u4RUH2HVCz8A). These states are entirely covered by shitcam.

clues.title: Landscape: A savannah landscape combined with rocky hills can most…
text: A **savannah **landscape combined with **rocky hills** can most commonly be seen in the northeast in the states of Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe, Adamawa, and the north of Taraba. The hills in the **far east and west **of this region are typically [greener](https://goo.gl/maps/Hmbqtpv3fxcGRKuLA)** **and covered in more vegetation compared to the hills toward the middle of the range.
NOTE: Around the city of Gombe, hills composed of softer, [clay-like soil](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icUUBKmdGQFN75eP9) can be seen instead.

clues.title: Landscape: These monolithic mountains with exposed
text: These monolithic mountains with **exposed, weathered rock **are common in and around Abuja.

clues.title: Landscape: A flat landscape with coastal vegetation and many palms can…
text: A flat landscape with coastal vegetation and **many palms** can be seen east of Lekki. The ground is very **sandy**. Almost all of the coverage is old Generation 3, with a [silver follow car](https://www.google.com/maps/@6.4185992,4.079123,3a,15y,284.01h,83.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sTrh0nQY2S9hrUGN-v1ejng!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).

clues.title: Vegetation: The A121 can be recognized by the lush
text: The A121 can be recognized by the lush, **tropical **vegetation surrounding the **divided **highway, with a short, concrete median. Being a major highway, many vehicles, especially trucks, can be seen along it.
NOTE: The A232 heading east of Benin City is also divided, however the median is [noticeably wider](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hbkv1uPKkgqTr3hD9) than that of the A121.

clues.title: Google car: The A3 going east of Potiskum to the Borno State border can…
text: The A3 going east of Potiskum to the Borno State border can be recognized by the Generation 4 coverage, mostly **open arid landscape**, and the highway being **divided**.

clues.title: Landscape: Dark red soil is most commonly found in and around Benin…
text: **Dark red soil** is most commonly found in and around Benin City and Enugu.
NOTE: Red-tinged soil can be found in many places. This tip refers specifically to dark red soil.

clues.title: Landscape: The Obudu Plateau road can be recognized by having the…
text: The Obudu Plateau road can be recognized by having the **tallest mountains **in Nigeria with street view coverage. The road winds up **lush, green** mountains and the coverage is slightly foggy and wet.

text: This map shows where each **old Generation 3** follow car can be found. They are uncommon, but can still be useful to know.

NOTE: The A121 is not shown on the map as it is recognizable from other clues. This [silver Lexus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/i36WGpXJW9q2fHhh7), not shown on the map, can rarely be seen on the highway between Onitsha and Enugu.
